title: "Govt.'s Super-Secret Security Agency Warns: Take UFOs Seriously or be Prepared for Sneak Invasion by Space Aliens." The National Enquirer. November 27, 1979
doc_notes: This is a National Enquirer article summarizing a declassified, heavily censored 1968 NSA report on UFOs; it contains no specific firsthand encounter narratives, only brief mentions of locations.

encounters.summary: Two spacecraft reported hovering over Dulce, New Mexico, as referenced in an NSA report.
